_doc: Team decisions after discussing Hani's review (2026-10-10). outcome = Hani's recommended outcome; acceptable_outcomes = alternatives Hani explicitly called defensible in the review text. Scored as 'outcome acceptable' next to 'outcome exact'. Test-split reviews are used ONLY to correct gold, never to change a system.

c-8149.why: Hani: escalation for improving the fallback/dev-port design is also reasonable

c-13521.why: Hani: a support reply offering a free port (--server.port) is also useful

c-8364.why: Hani: targeted diagnostics (headless, usage-stats/version-check settings) are acceptable next steps

c-9781.why: Hani: immediate routing to Cloud support is also defensible if escalation means ownership routing

c-15378.why: Hani: escalation with the minimal example remains reasonable

c-5793.why: Hani: a targeted diagnostic response is also defensible

c-8321.why: Hani: escalate if it reproduces after a clean install

scenario_notes.s-15378: Intake outcome changed to info_request (bucket ambiguous). expected_final stays 'escalated': it describes the state AFTER the user tried the suggested setting and it did not help.
